title: Collect Entra operational log on pending user affinity (event 1098)
description: Collects the most recent Entra token-broker operational events with ID 1098 from Microsoft-Windows-AAD/Operational the moment the agent reports that the signed-in user still has no Entra user token (entra_user_affinity_pending). Captures the OS-side token-broker record at exactly the point where ANALYZE-ID-004 draws its evidence. The event log collector filters on one event ID per rule; GATHER-DEVICE-008 collects event 1097 from the same channel.
author: Autopilot Monitor
